name: synapsedeck
description: Control Razer Synapse 4 software profiles from Elgato Stream Deck through SynapseCTRL.

scripts.validate: npm run build && streamdeck validate --no-update-check com.gabrielzv1233.synapsedeck.sdPlugin
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack --no-update-check --force --output dist com.gabrielzv1233.synapsedeck.sdPlugin
scripts.watch: npm run assets && rollup -c -w --watch.onEnd="streamdeck restart com.gabrielzv1233.synapsedeck"
